notes: Wattle Notes 0.1.13 developer alpha. Google sign-in is configured in macOS, Linux and Windows distribution builds; standard release commands reject missing Google client configuration and native executables are checked before packaging upload. Download Linux x64 DEB and Windows x64 EXE/MSI installers from the matching GitHub release. macOS Apple Silicon in-app updates retain the established signing key and signed-version checks. Legacy note identity fields and application/credential identifiers remain stable to preserve existing notebooks, sync history and saved connections. Mostly vibe coded with AI assistance. The Mac bundle is ad-hoc signed, not Apple Developer ID signed or notarized; Windows installers are unsigned. Packaged Windows/Linux interactive sign-in and sync acceptance remain pending.
